task: Before planning, read kernel_src/EXPERIMENT_CONTEXT.md completely and use it as mandatory campaign memory. Spend the full 32-direction budget unless correctness or infrastructure prevents useful progress. Optimize the hybrid seed into a compact family of standalone FlyDSL gfx1201 kernels that replaces vLLM's Triton SplitKV fallback across the entire 66-case manifest. Preserve the current FP8 GQA-6/7 winner and never optimize, edit, or disguise a Triton fallback as FlyDSL progress. Candidate work must remain inside kernel_src; add local FlyDSL modules there and use the pinned external kernel only as a read-only seed/reference. The full operation includes stage 1 and cross-split reduction with caller-owned output and FP32 scratch. Cover BF16/FP16 query and output, matching BF16/FP16 caches, OCP E4M3FN and E4M3FNUZ caches with independent scalar FP32 scales, D=128/256, GQA 1-16, one/two/four KV heads, runtime page sizes, arbitrary finite softmax scales, split counts 2/4/8/16, batch one, and ragged batches. Require five fresh live-Triton draws at rtol=atol=0.01, output independence, current-input dependence, exact padded cache strides, and correct empty/tail split behavior. Every case is a correctness gate; every retained/zero-weight case must remain at least 0.98x. Bank only reproducible >=0.5% gains that add or improve a general FlyDSL route bucket with source or trace engagement proof. Do not use exact case/sequence/shape tables, model identity, output or operand memoization, persistent result reuse, hidden precomputation, host synchronization, allocation/JIT inside timing, AITER, CK, CDNA MFMA, or direct upstream MLIR operations. Start by repairing the GQA 1-5 numerical issue and GQA-8 row corruption, then build compile-time GQA families for 1, 2-4, 5-7, 8, and 9-16; add D=128 and dtype-specialized load/dequant paths; then optimize ragged scheduling, logical token tiles, LDS layouts, prefetch, split scratch, and reduction launch cost. Use stable fx.*, tiled copy/MMA, SharedAllocator, gfx12 wait/signal, and _run_compiled APIs. Inspect ISA and record VGPR/SGPR/LDS/workgroup data for retained variants. The primary score is the ratio of sums over 58 equally weighted Triton-owned cases, but also report per-family and worst-case speedups plus the exact number of scored cases with proven FlyDSL engagement. Full success means all 58 scored cases are FlyDSL-routed, all gates pass, and the weighted result beats the frozen hybrid seed. Finish with cache-controlled paired order-reversed timings, CUDA graph replay, and representative ATT traces; if full replacement is not achieved, explicitly list the remaining fallback families.

op_spec.implementation: standalone FlyDSL gfx1201 SplitKV router replacing vLLM Triton fallback
op_spec.layout_contract: K is [blocks,kv_heads,D/x,page,x], V is [blocks,kv_heads,D,page], x=16/itemsize, innermost axes contiguous, block stride may be padded, and block tables may permute physical pages.
op_spec.math_contract: Online softmax and split merge use FP32 state. FP8 K/V use independent scalar FP32 scales before BF16/FP16 dot consumption. Matching BF16/FP16 caches are unscaled. Cast output once to query dtype.
op_spec.routing_contract: Use compact families based on dtype, D, GQA bucket, batch/grid occupancy, page geometry, and context tiles. Never route by exact manifest case, exact sequence length, exact full shape tuple, or model identity.
